intended_object: The inclusion map s ↪ M of an open subset s of a C^n manifold M, viewed as a smooth embedding: it is C^n, an immersion, and a homeomorphism onto its image. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: `SmoothEmbedding I J n M N` bundles a C^n map with a proof of Mathlib's predicate `Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding`. `ofOpens` takes the underlying map to be `Subtype.val : s → M`, the inclusion. Its smoothness and embedding property come from Mathlib's lemma `Manifold.IsSmoothEmbedding.of_opens`. The open subset gets its usual induced charted-space structure with the same model `I`, so both sides use `I`. This is the standard open-subset inclusion. The only assumption is `[IsManifold I n M]`, which the Mathlib lemma also needs, so the generality is the natural one. Mathlib has no bundled smooth-embedding structure, only the predicate and the lemma above (a lemma, not a definition), so there is no Mathlib definition to cite as a counterpart.
